rfid-handhelds.name: RFID Handheld Series
rfid-handhelds.tagline: One range. Three RFID bands. Two performance tiers.
rfid-handhelds.summary: A 5.5-inch Android RFID handheld range with LF, HF and UHF configurations, plus a long-range UHF model for bulk inventory and asset audits.
overview: The RFID Handheld Series brings LF, HF and UHF identification onto a shared 5.5-inch Android handheld format. HT540 configurations cover close-range tags, cards and item-level UHF counts, while HT550 adds a long-range UHF module and a larger battery for bulk inventory.

Choose the band and performance tier for the work, then confirm the scan engine, NFC, PSAM and accessory options for the target market. Regional UHF bands and final specifications are confirmed against the approved datasheet.

lf.label: HT540 LF
lf.name: HT540-LF
lf.summary: LF RFID handheld for animal ID, access control and close-range asset tags.

features.title: Low-frequency reads where it matters
features.body: Read 125 kHz and 134.2 kHz FDX-B/HDX tags within 10 cm, with strong performance around non-metallic materials.

features.title: Purpose-built for animal and access tags
features.body: Support livestock, animal identification and access-control workflows on a rugged Android handheld.

features.title: Add barcode and NFC
features.body: Combine LF identification with optional 1D/2D barcode scanning and NFC for mixed data-capture tasks.

features.title: Same rugged platform
features.body: IP65 protection, a 1.2 m drop rating and a replaceable 4,900 mAh battery support full-shift field use.

hf.label: HT540 HF
hf.name: HT540-HF
hf.summary: HF RFID handheld for cards, labels and NFC identification at close range.

features.title: Close-range card and label reads
features.body: Read HF cards, labels and NFC tags at 1–3 cm for controlled identification and verification workflows.

features.title: NFC built in
features.body: Support NFC-IP1/2, M1 cards and CPU cards alongside HF RFID on the same device.

features.title: PSAM for secure workflows
features.body: Add a PSAM module for projects that require secure card authentication and regional access standards.

features.title: A shared Android platform
features.body: Android 10, a 5.5-inch display and the same battery and accessory ecosystem as the rest of the series.

uhf.label: HT540 UHF
uhf.name: HT540-UHF
uhf.summary: UHF RFID handheld for item-level stock counts, asset audits and short-range inventory reads.
highlights: UHF 860–960 MHz with regional band configuration
1–3 m read range with a 3 dBi ceramic antenna
Optional barcode scanner, NFC and PSAM

features.title: Short-range UHF that fits the aisle
features.body: Read item tags at 1–3 m with a 3 dBi circularly polarized antenna, suited to shelf counts, cycle counts and asset audits.

features.title: One platform, familiar operation
features.body: The same 5.5-inch Android 10 device, scan keys, battery and accessories as the LF and HF versions keep training consistent.

features.title: Scan and identify together
features.body: Add a 1D/2D barcode scanner to combine tag reads with label, shelf and asset checks in one workflow.

features.title: Built for daily handling
features.body: IP65 protection, a 1.2 m drop rating and an easily replaceable battery support full-shift use.

ht550.label: HT550
ht550.name: HT550
ht550.summary: Long-range UHF RFID handheld with Android 13, a 9,600 mAh battery and optional barcode scanning.
highlights: Impinj E-series UHF module with 4 dBi circular antenna
1–20 m module rating; about 15 m with Impinj MR6 tag outdoors

features.title: Long-range bulk reads
features.body: Read UHF tags at up to 15 m with an Impinj MR6 tag in open outdoor conditions, with a module rating of 1–20 m depending on tag and environment.

features.title: All-shift battery
features.body: The 9,600 mAh battery supports more than 10 hours of work, with 18 W charging for high-intensity counting shifts.

features.title: Fast group reading
features.body: Capture up to 2,000 tags per 10 seconds to shorten cycle counts and asset audits.

features.title: Handheld ergonomics
features.body: A 5.5-inch 720 × 1440 display, physical scan keys and a 680 g body with IP67 host protection.

ht600.name: HT600
ht600.summary: A 6.0-inch Android 13 industrial handheld with a professional 1D/2D scan engine, IP68 protection and an 8,000 mAh battery for logistics, warehousing and field data capture.
overview: HT600 is a 6.0-inch Android 13 industrial handheld built around a professional 1D/2D image scan engine. The 8,000 mAh detachable battery, IP68 protection and 1.8 m drop rating are specified for full-shift work in warehouses, delivery and field operations.

The platform pairs a 16 MP rear camera, 4G LTE, dual-band Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.0 with optional NFC, LF RFID and a pistol grip. Scan engine, memory and module options are confirmed per configuration and target market; the approved datasheet is the reference for ordering.

standard.label: Standard
standard.name: HT600
standard.summary: 6.0-inch Android 13 barcode handheld with an 8,000 mAh battery, IP68 protection and a professional 1D/2D scan engine.
highlights: Professional 1D/2D image scan engine with multiple decode options
8,000 mAh detachable battery and IP68 protection
6.0-inch high-brightness display with glove and wet touch

features.title: Fast barcode capture
features.body: A professional 1D/2D image engine reads common 1D and 2D codes, with soft- and hard-decode engine options confirmed per configuration.

features.title: Full-shift power
features.body: The 8,000 mAh detachable battery supports more than 12 hours of work, with fast charging and RTC battery replacement for shift changes.

features.title: Rugged field design
features.body: IP68 protection, a 1.8 m six-sided drop rating and an operating range of -30 to 60 °C support warehouse, delivery and outdoor work.

features.title: Android platform and connectivity
features.body: Android 13, 4G LTE, dual-band Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5.0 and optional NFC or LF RFID connect the device to the workflow and the systems behind it.

y100.name: Y100 Series
y100.summary: A 10.1-inch Android rugged tablet platform with dedicated standard, RFID, RTK, fingerprint and 5G configurations for inventory, inspection, field service and surveying.
overview: Y100 Series is built around a 10.1-inch Android tablet with a 10,000 mAh battery, IP67 protection and a shared accessory ecosystem. The standard version covers everyday mobile computing and optional data capture.

Dedicated configurations add integrated UHF RFID, centimetre-level RTK, a fingerprint module or 5G connectivity. Choose the version that matches the work, then confirm module options, regional bands and certifications for the target market.

standard.label: Standard
standard.name: Y100 Standard
standard.summary: The base 10.1-inch Android 16 tablet for mobile work, inspection and optional data capture.
highlights: Optional barcode, NFC, UHF RFID and fingerprint

features.title: A field-ready Android tablet
features.body: A 10.1-inch display, MT6789 8-core platform and Android 16 handle inspection, work-order and asset applications.

features.title: All-day battery
features.body: The 10,000 mAh battery and 30 W PD charging support long shifts in the field.

features.title: Configure the capture you need
features.body: Add 1D/2D scanning, NFC, UHF RFID or a fingerprint module for the workflow.

features.title: Rugged by design
features.body: IP67 protection, a 1.0 m drop rating and glove / wet-hand touch support.

rfid.label: RFID
rfid.name: Y100 RFID
rfid.summary: A 10.1-inch rugged tablet with an integrated Impinj UHF RFID module for inventory and asset audits.
highlights: Impinj E710 / E510 / R2000 UHF module
Up to 10 m read range, 150+ tags per second

features.title: Integrated UHF RFID
features.body: Read and write EPC C1 Gen2 / ISO 18000-6C tags with a built-in Impinj module and 4 dBi antenna.

features.title: Cover more per pass
features.body: Read up to 10 m in open outdoor conditions and capture 150+ tags per second.

features.title: A larger RFID workspace
features.body: The 10.1-inch display gives inventory and exception workflows more room than a handheld.

features.title: Shared rugged platform
features.body: IP67, a 10,000 mAh battery and the same accessories as the rest of the Y100 Series.

rtk.label: RTK
rtk.name: Y100 RTK
rtk.summary: A 10.1-inch rugged RTK tablet for centimetre-level surveying, GIS and field positioning.

features.title: Centimetre-level positioning
features.body: A 1408-channel RTK module delivers 2.5 cm horizontal accuracy for surveying, GIS and precision field work.

features.title: Readable outdoors
features.body: The 10.1-inch 800-nit display supports outdoor mapping and inspection in bright conditions.

features.title: RTK antenna port
features.body: A top-mounted antenna port connects the external RTK antenna for field setups.

features.title: Field-ready battery
features.body: A 10,000 mAh battery and 30 W PD charging support long survey days.

fingerprint.label: Fingerprint
fingerprint.name: Y100 Fingerprint
fingerprint.summary: A 10.1-inch rugged tablet with a FAP10/FAP20 fingerprint module for identity-aware workflows.

features.title: Identity at the point of work
features.body: A FAP10/FAP20 fingerprint module supports operator login and identity verification on the tablet.

features.title: One device for the job
features.body: Combine fingerprint verification with barcode, NFC or UHF RFID options on the same 10.1-inch platform.

features.title: Built for shared devices
features.body: Fingerprint sign-in helps teams share a device while keeping individual accountability.

features.title: Rugged and portable
features.body: IP67 protection, a 1.0 m drop rating and a 10,000 mAh battery.

5g.label: 5G
5g.name: Y100 5G
5g.summary: A 10.1-inch 5G rugged tablet for connected field work and bandwidth-heavy applications.

features.title: 5G in the field
features.body: 5G NR connectivity supports live video, large uploads and cloud-connected field applications.

features.title: A platform built for connectivity
features.body: UNISOC 7885, Android 13 and 5G NR bands cover markets where 5G coverage is available.

features.title: Optional field modules
features.body: Add barcode, NFC, UHF RFID, fingerprint or RTK modules for the workflow.

features.title: All-day field power
features.body: A 10,000 mAh battery supports more than 12 hours of work depending on environment.
